$comment: Vertical-slice art assets. Sizes are BASE-GRID pixels (480x270 canvas, shown x4 at 1080p). tools/codex/art.mjs generates each at native gpt-image size into art/raw/<id>.png and snaps it into godot/assets/<id>.png. Add an asset = add an entry here; the id is the file path under godot/assets/.

kinds.scene: A full-frame environment layer. Paint it as a finished game background: every surface has material shading, the lighting is unified, nothing is a placeholder. Composition must leave the centre-bottom area (where a customer bust will stand in front of the counter) uncluttered enough that a character reads clearly against it.
kinds.portrait: A head-and-shoulders bust for dialogue, cut off cleanly at roughly the chest/upper-arm line as in Coffee Talk (the counter hides the rest). Facing the viewer, slight three-quarter allowed. Transparent background. Same pixel density and outline weight as the target-state reference so every cast member matches.
kinds.icon: A single tiny pixel icon drawn on a deliberately coarse grid: render it as a 16x16 (or the stated size) pixel-art icon scaled up to fill the canvas with big, crisp, uniform square pixels and no anti-aliasing, so it downsamples cleanly. Flat 3-5 colour palette, 1-px dark outline, readable silhouette.
kinds.prop: A single small object as a game sprite, transparent background, front/slightly-above view consistent with sitting on the counter, clean outline, Coffee Talk material shading.

assets.prompt: The interior of a Berlin Späti at night, seen from behind the counter (the shopkeeper's fixed side-on view), with NO people and NO counter in frame — this is the back layer behind the customer. Left third: a tall wall of glowing drinks fridges with cyan-white interior light and rows of generic bottles (green beer bottles with plain labels, yellow-label Mate-like bottles, water, cola-like). Middle: wooden shelves of stand-in snacks (chips bags, chocolate bars, gum) and tobacco pouches, a hand-painted warm neon 'SPÄTI' sign glowing above, a techno flyer and a small U-Bahn-style sign pinned to dark wood panelling, a hanging plant, a football scarf (no real club) draped on a hook. Right third: the glass door and window onto the street — cold blue rainy Berlin night outside, wet reflections, a magenta neon glow from across the street, stickers on the inside of the glass. Warm amber pendant lamps overhead; the floor is not visible. Dense but readable 'wall of cozy stuff' like the Coffee Talk café, re-skinned as a kiosk.

The foreground counter band of a Berlin Späti seen from the shopkeeper's side, as a wide horizontal strip: a worn warm-brown wooden counter top with 4-5 tone wood grain and a bright amber highlight band along its front edge, filling the bottom ~40% of the canvas edge to edge. On it, from left to right: a plastic Pfand crate holding a few empty green bottles, a small ceramic coffee cup on a saucer, a mobile phone lying face-up, and at the right a compact cash register with a tiny glowing display. EVERYTHING above the counter surface and the objects on it must be transparent (real alpha) — no wall, no background, no people.

Title-screen key art: the exterior of a small Berlin Späti (corner kiosk) at night from across a rainy street, in the same pixel-art style. The shopfront glows warm amber through its window, drinks fridges visible inside, a hand-painted neon 'SPÄTI' sign above the door, stickers and posters on the glass, a crate of empty bottles by the door, wet cobblestones reflecting magenta and cyan neon, a U-Bahn-style sign on the corner, an old Berlin Altbau facade above with a few lit windows. A lone young man (the protagonist: messy wavy brown hair, red hoodie under a brown/black jacket with a red band) stands at the door holding a set of keys, seen from behind at three-quarter, small in frame. Leave the upper-middle sky/facade area calm enough for a title to be overlaid later. No text other than the SPÄTI sign.

The protagonist 'You' (Onkel Cem's nephew) — EXACTLY the man in the target-state reference: mid-20s, messy wavy brown hair, light stubble, tired-but-earnest brown eyes, red hoodie under a brown/black layered jacket with a red band across the sleeves. Neutral, slightly guarded expression, hands out of frame. Head-and-shoulders bust for a dialogue portrait.

Lena, a broke Berlin art student in her early 20s: pale, freckled, reddish-auburn hair escaping from a dark green beanie, a paint-flecked oversized denim jacket over a striped top, a silver hoop earring, an empty Mate-like bottle held up near her shoulder as her signature prop. Neutral expression with a proud, slightly evasive set to the mouth. Head-and-shoulders bust for a dialogue portrait, Coffee Talk proportions and outline weight.

'Bottle' Jürgen, a Flaschensammler (bottle collector) in his 60s: weathered, kind, deeply lined face, grey stubble, a dark knit cap, a worn olive parka with a frayed collar, fingerless gloves, a clear bag of empty bottles slung over his shoulder as his signature prop. Neutral, guarded, eyes that avoid contact. Head-and-shoulders bust for a dialogue portrait, Coffee Talk proportions and outline weight.

Mehmet, who runs the döner place next door, in his 50s: broad, warm face, a big grey-black moustache, short greying hair, a white paper hat, a dark apron over a rolled-sleeve shirt, a tea glass (tulip-shaped Turkish çay glass) held in one hand as his signature prop. Calm, watchful, faintly amused. Head-and-shoulders bust for a dialogue portrait, Coffee Talk proportions and outline weight.

Blissed-out, tired, smiling. Head-and-shoulders bust for a dialogue portrait, Coffee Talk proportions and outline weight.
